d: Artificial intelligence is transforming cybercrime. According to an IBM study, one in four breaches between March 2025 and February 2026 was AI-enabled, while AI-assisted hacking attacks rose 56% over the year. AI tools can scan code, find vulnerabilities and repeatedly probe systems far faster than human hackers. But the same technology is also being used defensively. Researchers recently used AI to find long-hidden vulnerabilities in PHP, a programming language that powers a large share of the web. Governments and companies are now racing to patch exposed systems before attackers exploit…
